title: equisetum fluviatile f. uliginosum
intro: Equisetum fluviatile f. uliginosum, commonly known as marsh horsetail, is a subspecies of the Equisetum fluviatile plant, belonging to the Equisetaceae family. This perennial plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate conditions such as arthritis and improve overall cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Equisetum fluviatile f. uliginosum include its ability to stimulate blood circulation, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects on human health.
